name: Abhishek Kumar Prajapati
title: Abhishek Kumar Prajapati
description: Portfolio of Abhishek Kumar Prajapati: data scientist working on optimization, machine learning and generative AI for transportation, logistics and infrastructure.
role: Senior Data Scientist at Optym, Dallas · Ph.D. in Transportation Engineering, Penn State
statement: I build optimization models and machine learning systems that help transportation and logistics networks run better at scale.
sub: My Ph.D. at Penn State combined simulation-based optimization, graph neural networks and generative models for large-scale infrastructure management. Today I apply the same tools to freight: mixed-integer models for dock planning, data pipelines over tens of millions of records, and retrieval-augmented generation for working with technical documents.

interests.text: Mixed-integer and simulation-based optimization for planning and operations at scale.

interests.title: Infrastructure asset management
interests.text: Maintenance scheduling and condition forecasting that account for traffic and reliability.

interests.title: Generative AI and RAG
interests.text: Retrieval-augmented generation and fine-tuned language models for technical and regulated domains.

interests.title: Computer vision for transportation
interests.text: Pavement distress segmentation, traffic monitoring and crowd density estimation.
